Linnk Group is looking for a Senior Business Analyst to join our Product team in Kochi. You’ll own requirements for a set of product areas and take them from discovery all the way through development, testing and release.

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration or a related field (a postgraduate degree is welcome, but practical product experience matters more to us)

Preferred

- Experience with multi-module, multi-tenant platforms

- Working knowledge of LLM applications, including prompt engineering, RAG, evaluation and guardrails
